Neil Diamond – Serenade

Original 1974 Columbia Records release, catalog number PC 32919.

A classic Neil Diamond album featuring the hit single "Longfellow Serenade" along with fan favorites including "I've Been This Way Before" and "The Last Picasso."

This copy remains in its original shrink wrap and presents very nicely for its age.

Vinyl Condition (VG+)

  • Strong original gloss
  • Light surface marks visible under bright light
  • No deep scratches observed
  • Clean Columbia labels
  • Well-maintained copy
  • Expected to play well with light background noise typical of vintage vinyl

Cover Condition (VG+)

  • Original shrink wrap still present
  • Minor corner and edge wear visible through shrink
  • Front hype sticker intact:
    "Featuring the Hit Single Longfellow Serenade"
  • Clean presentation overall
  • Excellent display copy

Track Listing

Side One

  • I've Been This Way Before
  • Rosemary's Wine
  • Lady Magdelene
  • The Last Picasso

Side Two

  • Longfellow Serenade
  • Yes I Will
  • Reggae Strut
  • The Gift of Song
